description: Make the mesh levels (LOD) and the optimised textures of a model on this machine, with the SAME code as the GripForge service (same Rust simplifier meshoptimizer, same file, same cache key). From the passport of the model (kits.lod: defaults of the usage, the global passport, then the game's override). Use it when an asset arrives and before delivery; with project_id it reads what each bound model needs, makes only the missing copies and gives them to the server. A copy already current is not made again. Guide: gripforge_docs { topic: "lod" }. 0 credits.

bin.description: The simplifier binary gripforge-lod, for a platform without a prebuilt one.

dry_run.description: true: say what is missing, make nothing.

extra.description: A locomotion pack (.glb on the same skeleton) to merge, as the service does for a champion's kit.

kind.description: prop, character, enemy, creatures… decides the defaults (default: character if the model is skinned, else prop).

kit.description: A LOD kit folder you have (lod-kit.mjs); default: the release published with the CLI, checked and cached.

override.description: The game's keys over the passport (kits.lod): ratios, minTriangles, fit, maxError, screenSizes, castShadows, shadowLevel, shadowFit, minDistance, rule…

passport.description: Absolute path of the global passport of the model (.gfmesh.json). Default: <name>.gfmesh.json beside the model.

path.description: Absolute path of a model (.glb) or of a folder of models. Use this, or project_id.

profiles.description: Which copies: game (KTX2 textures when the encoder is there) and bevy (WebP, the Rust web player). Default both.

project_id.description: A Game Kit project (gkp_…): its bound models. The server says what each needs (effective passport: global, then the game's own asset_passports); the missing copies are made here and kept by the server.

push.description: project_id only; default true: send the copies made to the server, which then makes nothing for them.

name: gripforge_lod_build
title: Mesh levels (LOD) and optimised textures, made locally
